colourQualification: Raw encoded scan RGB medians and ranges only, not original ink codes. PDF ICCBased source used a calibrated monitor profile; extractedJPEG has no embeddedICC. Warm scan cast must be disclosed, not promoted to a factory brown/cream palette.

source.decodePolicy: Original JPEG bytes decoded with Pillow; no ICC transformation, alteration or resizing

graduationPlane.method: Threshold-derived light annulus edges on 1deg rays; individual robust conic fits and joint concentric-circle projective model

concentricProjectiveFit.assumption: Visible outer white circle and inner black circle were concentric in the photographed source plane; not a proven factory camera model
concentricProjectiveFit.method: Joint robust Gauss-Newton fit of two concentric circles; symmetric affine part fixes arbitrary rotation
